about: Display forms of the symbols vakint defines or emits (lane vakint-symbol-format, 2026-11-16). Templates per print mode; placeholders: ⟨i⟩ argument i, ⟨i:+⟩ signed coefficient (+, -, +n, -n, +(x)), ⟨i:p⟩ argument parenthesised when composite, ⟨i:vec⟩ a one-argument vector f(n) as f_n, parenthesise_as_power_base / parenthesise_in_product: the printer wraps the form in parentheses when it is the base of a power (p·q, m_i², Re H(x)) / a factor of a product (sign-led forms such as -g_s); a form itself never carries enclosing parentheses (user rule 2026-11-16, tested), ⟨*⟩ all arguments, ⟨1*⟩ arguments from 1, ⟨init⟩ all but the last, ⟨last⟩ the last argument. Plain (Symbolica), Mathematica and Sympy printing is never overridden: canonical and plain strings are unchanged. rust=true: registered by vakint (display.rs) when its vocabulary is created; rust=false: registered only by the Python twin tools/display/vakint_display.py, because the owner is foreign or because the symbol enters RustRed (heads, polynomial variables), which accepts only exportable symbols: a Symbolica print callback makes a symbol non-exportable (rust_exclusion gives the reason).
